provenance.method: Read source at this commit; every code reference is an anchor string located in the file at build time by docs/interactive-explorer/scripts/extract-snippets.mjs.
provenance.note: No step carries timing. Payload examples are shapes with values substituted from the explorer's request form; they are synthetic, not captured.

subject.request: POST /v1/chat/completions, text input; text or text+audio output

scenarios.speech: Text in, text + audio out (modalities=[text, audio]) on Qwen3OmniSpeechPipelineConfig

groups.label: speech-only stages · speech config: one process per stage

components.label: FastAPI chat_completions
components.why: Speak the OpenAI protocol without leaking it into the runtime.
components.owns: Route registration, request/response schemas, SSE framing, HTTP status mapping.
components.io: ChatCompletionRequest → GenerateRequest; CompletionResult / CompletionStreamChunk → JSON / SSE
components.concurrency: async handlers on the uvicorn event loop (HTTP process)
components.design: create_app only builds routes over a live Client; launch_server/run_server owns pipeline startup.
components.debug: Check the request_id and the converted GenerateRequest; 422 is schema, 503 is QueueFullError.

components.label: Client
components.why: One internal API shared by every HTTP route.
components.owns: GenerateRequest → OmniRequest conversion; GenerateChunk building; text/audio aggregation; stop-string trimming.
components.interfaces: generate, completion, completion_stream, speech, abort, health
components.classes: Client, build_omni_request, extract_inputs, build_params, default_result_builder, default_stream_builder
components.concurrency: async generators on the HTTP loop; stateless per request
components.design: result_builder / stream_builder are injectable so pipelines with other result shapes reuse the same client.
components.debug: Inspect the OmniRequest params dict: stream, max_new_tokens and stage_sampling all live there.

components.label: Coordinator
components.why: Own the request lifecycle across stages it does not understand.
components.owns: requests (RequestInfo), completion_futures, stream_queues, stream_backlogs, partial_results, abort tasks.
components.interfaces: submit, stream, submit_request, abort, run_completion_loop, handle_completion, handle_stream
components.io: OmniRequest → SubmitMessage(StagePayload); CompleteMessage / StreamMessage → future / stream queue
components.classes: Coordinator, CoordinatorControlPlane (PUSH submit, PULL completions, PUB abort)
components.concurrency: single asyncio loop in the HTTP process; run_completion_loop is a background task
components.design: Model-agnostic: knows only entry stage, terminal stages and an optional terminal_stages_resolver.
components.debug: RequestInfo.state and expected_terminal_stages explain most hangs; profiler events request_admission / terminal_response.

components.label: Stage: preprocessing (entry)
components.why: IO shell: separate inter-stage IO from compute.
components.owns: active_requests, aborted, stream_queue, replica_bindings, per-request stream counters.
components.interfaces: run, on_submit, on_data_ready, receive_local_payload, execute, drain_outbox, route_result, send_to_stage
components.io: SubmitMessage / DataReadyMessage / local payload → IncomingMessage; OutgoingMessage → next stage or coordinator
components.classes: Stage, StageControlPlane, InputHandler (DirectInput / AggregatedInput), CommEngine, LocalStageDispatcher
components.concurrency: coroutines on the process asyncio loop; scheduler in its own thread
components.design: Never branches on scheduler type; all schedulers share inbox/outbox/start/stop/abort.
components.debug: stage_input_received / stage_dispatch / stage_hop_sent events; check active_requests vs aborted.

components.label: SimpleScheduler + Qwen3OmniPreprocessor
components.why: Run a non-AR function per request behind the scheduler interface.
components.owns: inbox, outbox, aborted set, optional batch collection.
components.concurrency: dedicated thread; async compute functions run on the thread's own event loop
components.design: Serial by default for preprocessing: threaded dispatch changed thinker batch composition and greedy outputs.
components.debug: preprocess_start / preprocess_end events; prompt-length validation errors surface here.

components.label: Stage: image_encoder (skipped)
components.why: Vision encoder; reached only when the request has images or video.
components.concurrency: SimpleScheduler thread
components.design: Routed per request by resolve_preprocessing_next_stages.

components.label: Stage: audio_encoder (skipped)
components.why: Audio encoder; reached only when the request has audio.
components.concurrency: SimpleScheduler thread
components.design: Routed per request by resolve_preprocessing_next_stages.

components.label: Stage: mm_aggregate (fan-in)
components.why: Join preprocessing and encoder outputs into thinker inputs.
components.io: StagePayloads from wait_for sources → merged StagePayload (merge_for_thinker)
components.concurrency: input handler runs on the stage asyncio loop
components.design: wait_for_fn narrows static wait_for per request, so text-only requests do not wait on encoders.
components.debug: stage_aggregate_ready event; a request stuck here is missing an expected source.

components.label: SimpleScheduler (identity)
components.why: Graph join point; compute is trivial.
components.concurrency: dedicated thread
components.design: GPU placement only for colocation (factory note).

components.label: Stage: thinker
components.why: IO shell for the AR LLM stage.
components.concurrency: asyncio loop + scheduler-thinker thread
components.design: stream_to=["decode"] in text mode; speech mode adds talker_ar and dynamic stream-done targets.
components.debug: stage_first_stream_chunk_sent (stage=thinker) ≈ first token leaves the thinker.

components.label: OmniScheduler (thinker)
components.why: Reuse SGLang's AR scheduling inside a pipeline stage.
components.owns: waiting_queue / running_batch (upstream state), pending request builds, aborted_request_ids, async_pending decode step.
components.io: StagePayload → SGLang Req (request_builder); finished Req → StagePayload (result_adapter); tokens → stream OutgoingMessages
components.concurrency: dedicated thread; request-build thread pool; async-decode lookahead keeps two decode steps in flight
components.design: Composition: upstream Scheduler methods bound via __getattr__; overrides recv_requests, process_input_requests, run_batch, stream_output.

components.label: SGLang upstream (Scheduler, TpModelWorker, KV)
components.why: Batch selection, radix cache, KV pools, CUDA graphs, attention kernels.
components.concurrency: runs on the scheduler-thinker thread
components.design: External boundary: this explorer does not describe its internals as verified.
components.debug: SGLang server-args overrides via engine.* in the stage config.

components.label: Qwen3OmniThinkerModelRunner
components.why: Model-specific hooks around a shared forward/sample path.
components.owns: sampling seeds, host staging buffers, prompt hidden store (speech).
components.interfaces: execute, execute_launch, execute_resolve, before_prefill, custom_prefill_forward, post_prefill/decode
components.concurrency: scheduler-thinker thread, GPU streams
components.design: Text-only prefill attaches plain text embeds as a sidecar so breakable prefill CUDA graphs apply.
components.debug: Use the omni-gpu-deep-dive skill / torch profiler for kernel time.

components.label: Stage: decode (terminal)
components.why: Terminal stage: turn token ids into text and report to the coordinator.
components.owns: per-request stream state on the Stage side.
components.concurrency: asyncio loop + scheduler-decode thread
components.design: can_accept_stream_before_payload=True because token chunks precede the thinker's payload.
components.debug: stage_first_stream_chunk_sent (to coordinator) ≈ first text byte toward the client.

components.label: StreamingDetokenizeScheduler
components.why: UTF-8-safe incremental detokenization.
components.io: stream_chunk / stream_done / new_request → text deltas + final result
components.concurrency: dedicated thread polling inbox with 0.1s timeout
components.design: Handles stream_done before or after the payload.
components.debug: A request whose payload never arrives keeps state until abort.

components.label: Stage: talker_ar (gpu 1)
components.why: IO shell for the talker AR model: fan-in of prompt state plus a stream of thinker tokens.
components.owns: pre-payload stream queue; code2wav stream target.
components.io: preprocessing/encoder payloads + thinker token stream → codec code stream + latch payload
components.concurrency: own process (speech config), asyncio loop + scheduler thread
components.design: can_accept_stream_before_payload=True: thinker tokens may arrive before the fan-in payload is complete.

components.label: QwenTalkerScheduler
components.why: An OmniScheduler with talker-specific readiness.
components.concurrency: dedicated thread
components.design: Starts after partial_start_min_chunks thinker tokens; excludes decode rows whose next text has not arrived.
components.debug: 'talker rows excluded from a decode step' log line counts stalls.

components.label: QwenTalkerModelRunner
components.why: Talker forward with a feedback loop: each step's codec embedding is the next step's input together with thinker text.
components.io: ScheduleBatch → codec codes (stream to code2wav) + feedback rows
components.concurrency: talker scheduler thread, GPU 1
components.design: Emits code chunks straight into the outbox; coalesces 10 rows after the first 10.
components.debug: Check codec_coalesce_* factory args vs code2wav window size.

components.label: Stage: code2wav (terminal if audio)
components.why: Terminal stage turning codec codes into waveform.
components.owns: per-request stream state on the Stage side.
components.io: code stream + latch payload → audio StreamMessages + CompleteMessage
components.concurrency: own process on GPU 0 (or inside the talker's process when colocated)
components.design: gpu_memory_fraction=0.02; terminal_stages_fn adds it only for audio requests.

components.label: Code2WavScheduler
components.why: Windowed streaming vocoder.
components.owns: Code2WavStreamState per request: chunks, audio_parts, pending window, pinned slots.
components.concurrency: dedicated thread; decode stream; pinned D2H slots
components.design: stream_chunk_size=10 new frames per window with left_context_size=25; groups same-length windows across requests.
components.debug: No audio at all raises 'code2wav produced no audio' unless NO_SPEECH.

steps.title: FastAPI handler receives the request
steps.state: Assigns request_id (req.request_id or uuid4) and response_id. No runtime state yet.
steps.errors: Schema validation fails with 422 before the handler runs.
steps.rationale: The HTTP layer only translates the OpenAI protocol; it never touches stages.

steps.title: ChatCompletionRequest → GenerateRequest
steps.outputPayload:
GenerateRequest(
  messages=[Message(role="user", content="{{prompt}}")],
  sampling=SamplingParams(max_new_tokens={{max_tokens}}, stop=[], ...),
  stream={{stream}},
  max_tokens={{max_tokens}},
  output_modalities=["text"],   # req.modalities or ["text"]
  metadata={},                  # no media in this request
  extra_params={}
)
steps.state: None (pure conversion).
steps.errors: SamplingParams(**params) for stage_sampling can raise on unknown keys.
steps.rationale: The one place OpenAI field names become runtime names: media and video options go into metadata, talker overrides into extra_params.

steps.title: Client: GenerateRequest → OmniRequest
steps.state: None; the client is stateless per request.
steps.errors: extract_inputs raises ValueError unless exactly one of prompt / prompt_token_ids / messages is set.
steps.rationale: One internal API serves chat, speech, /generate and realtime routes, so the Coordinator only ever sees OmniRequest.

steps.title: Coordinator admits the request and wraps it in a StagePayload
steps.state:
requests[rid] = RequestInfo(state=PENDING, terminal_stages={"decode"}) → RUNNING after send.
completion_futures[rid] = Future.
stream only: stream_queues[rid] = asyncio.Queue(), stream_backlogs[rid] = StreamBacklog(0, now).
steps.errors: fatal_error → RuntimeError; duplicate ID → ValueError; in-flight cap → QueueFullError (HTTP 503). A failed send drops the request without an abort (no stage holds it yet).
steps.rationale: The Coordinator owns lifecycle (admission, terminal collection, abort) and stays model-agnostic.

steps.title: SubmitMessage over ZMQ PUSH to the entry stage
steps.output: msgpack bytes on the stage's PULL endpoint
steps.state: stage_sockets["preprocessing"] = PushSocket (lazily connected once).
steps.crossProcess: ZMQ PUSH → PULL. HTTP process → pipeline process. The first StagePayload is small (chat messages only), so it rides inside the control message; no relay is involved.
steps.errors: A ZMQ send either queues the whole message or raises.
steps.rationale: ZMQ carries coordination and small control metadata; bulk tensors use the comm layer (not needed on this path).

steps.title: Preprocessing Stage: on_submit → execute → scheduler inbox

code.anchor: async def on_submit(self, msg: SubmitMessage) -> None:

steps.state: active_requests.add(rid); stream_queue.open(rid).
steps.errors: A request ID in self.aborted (retired after abort/failure) is refused with send_failure.
steps.rationale: Stage is an IO shell: it never branches on scheduler type, all compute goes through inbox/outbox.

steps.title: Preprocessing compute: chat template, tokenize, build pipeline state

code.anchor: def run_single(self, msg: IncomingMessage, loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop) -> None:

steps.outputPayload:
payload.data = Qwen3OmniPipelineState(
  prompt={"prompt_text": "<|im_start|>user\n{{prompt}}<|im_end|>\n<|im_start|>assistant\n",
          "input_ids": Tensor[n_tokens], "attention_mask": Tensor[n_tokens]},
  mm_inputs={...}, encoder_inputs={...},   # no model inputs: no media
  stream_state={"token_ids": [], "text": ""}
).to_dict()
payload.request.inputs = None   # raw inputs dropped
steps.state: payload.request.inputs cleared; media keys popped from metadata so later hops do not carry raw media.
steps.errors: An exception becomes OutgoingMessage(type="error"); the stage turns it into CompleteMessage(success=False). Prompt too long for max_new_tokens raises in validate_prompt_text_len.
steps.rationale: Serial by default (max_concurrency=1): threaded dispatch changed thinker batch composition and flipped greedy bf16 MoE answers in CI (factory comment).

steps.title: Route the preprocessing result (data-driven)
steps.state: None yet; clear_request_state(rid) runs after routing on this stage.
steps.errors: Routing exceptions propagate to the outbox drain task (stage background-task failure).
steps.rationale: Per-request routing: a text request skips image_encoder and audio_encoder although they exist in the topology.

steps.title: Hop preprocessing → mm_aggregate (local_object)
steps.output: StagePayload (projected: prompt, lightweight mm_inputs, encoder metadata, stream_state)
steps.state: None on the sender; the receiver records it next.
steps.crossProcess: None. Same OS process (process="pipeline") and single target → Python object passed by reference. No serialization, ZMQ, or relay.
steps.errors: Missing endpoint/dispatcher raises RuntimeError.
steps.rationale: LOCAL_OBJECT is the cheapest transport; receivers must treat the object as read-only.

steps.title: mm_aggregate fan-in: AggregatedInput → merge_for_thinker
steps.outputPayload:
expected_sources = {"preprocessing"}   # narrowed per request
merge_for_thinker({"preprocessing": payload}) →
  state.thinker_inputs = build_thinker_inputs(...)
  state.encoder_inputs = {}; state.encoder_outs = {}
steps.state: AggregatedInput.pending[rid] exists only until all expected sources arrived (immediately here).
steps.errors: A source outside the expected set raises ValueError.
steps.rationale: Fan-in happens in the Stage's input handler, before the scheduler; the mm_aggregate scheduler is an identity function.

steps.title: mm_aggregate identity scheduler → route to thinker
steps.state: mm_aggregate clears its request state after routing.
steps.errors: Same as any SimpleScheduler stage.
steps.rationale: The aggregate stage exists as a join point in the graph; placing it on GPU is for colocation only (factory note).

steps.title: Thinker Stage → OmniScheduler.enqueue
steps.state: early_request_build_futures[rid] may be set if an early build was submitted.
steps.errors: None here.
steps.rationale: Early request builds start the CPU-side Req construction from the stage thread ahead of the scheduler loop.

steps.title: OmniScheduler builds a SGLang Req
steps.function: event_loop_async_decode → recv_requests → process_input_requests → run_request_builder → request_builder → build_sglang_thinker_request

code.anchor: request_class = QwenPromptHiddenRequest if has_prompt_rows else QwenThinkerRequest

steps.state: pending_request_builds[rid] while the build runs on the pool.
steps.errors: Build failure → emit_request_error (OutgoingMessage type=error) + abort(rid).
steps.rationale: Adapters translate between the pipeline's StagePayload and SGLang's Req, so the upstream scheduler runs unmodified.

steps.title: Admission into SGLang's waiting_queue
steps.output: req in waiting_queue with req.omni_data = req_data
steps.state: req.omni_data, req._omni_terminal_claimed = False, waiting_queue grows.
steps.errors: Empty prompt, context-length overflow (prepare_request_limits), KV capacity (request_kv_capacity_error), or queued limit → emit_request_error + abort.
steps.rationale: After this point the request is an ordinary SGLang Req: batch selection, radix cache, chunked prefill, and KV allocation are upstream.

steps.title: Upstream SGLang selects a prefill batch
steps.function: self.get_next_batch_to_run() resolved by OmniScheduler.__getattr__ on the upstream Scheduler class
steps.callee: upstream Scheduler.get_next_batch_to_run (prefix match, KV allocation, chunking)
steps.state: KV slots allocated in token_to_kv_pool; req_pool_idx assigned; possible radix-cache prefix hit.
steps.errors: Upstream retraction / OOM handling applies.
steps.rationale: Composition instead of inheritance: reuse SGLang's scheduling while overriding only intake, execution and output.
steps.uncertainty: The delegation via OmniScheduler.__getattr__ is verified; what upstream SGLang get_next_batch_to_run does inside (prefix match, KV allocation, chunking) is described from SGLang's design and was not read in this checkout.

steps.title: ModelRunner: build ForwardBatch → before_prefill → forward → sample
steps.outputPayload: next_token_ids = Tensor[batch]  # first generated token for "{{request_id}}"
steps.state: KV cache written for the prompt; req.output_ids grows by one per step.
steps.errors: run_batch catches exceptions → handle_batch_failure fails the batch's requests.
steps.rationale: Hooks (before_prefill / custom_prefill_forward / post_prefill) inject multimodal embeddings; with no media, Qwen attaches plain text input embeds as a sidecar so breakable prefill CUDA graphs still apply.

steps.title: Per-token stream output to decode
steps.state: first_emit_done.add(rid) on the first chunk.
steps.errors: A builder exception fails only that request (emit_request_error + abort).
steps.rationale: Only stream=true requests stream tokens to decode; non-stream requests deliver text only with the final result. Middle chunks of a chunked prefill are skipped.

steps.title: Decode steps with async lookahead (repeats per token)
steps.output: one token per request per step; stream chunks as in the previous step (stream=true)
steps.state: async_pending holds the launched step; previous step resolved and its results processed.
steps.errors: handle_batch_failure on launch or resolve failure.
steps.rationale: Launch-first keeps two decode steps in flight so CPU scheduling overlaps GPU execution.

steps.title: Thinker → decode stream chunk (local)
steps.state: thinker: local_stream_targets[rid] ∋ "decode"; decode: active_requests.add(rid) (stream before payload).
steps.errors: route_stream_item_or_fail turns routing errors into request failure.
steps.rationale: decode has can_accept_stream_before_payload=True because token chunks arrive before the thinker's final payload.

steps.title: Decode: incremental detokenize → text delta
steps.state: request_states[rid].pending_tokens cleared after a clean UTF-8 decode; kept if the text ends with U+FFFD.
steps.errors: An exception isolates the request: abort its state and emit OutgoingMessage(type="error").
steps.rationale: Holding incomplete UTF-8 sequences avoids streaming broken characters.

steps.title: Decode stream → Coordinator (StreamMessage over ZMQ)
steps.state: stream_chunk_counters[(rid, "coordinator")] += 1; first_stream_chunk_seen.add(rid).
steps.crossProcess: ZMQ PUSH (stage) → PULL (coordinator completion endpoint). Pipeline process → HTTP process. One message per text delta.
steps.errors: Non-terminal stage emitting an untargeted stream raises RuntimeError.
steps.rationale: Only terminal stages talk to the coordinator; inner streams go stage-to-stage.

steps.title: Coordinator → Client → SSE delta
steps.function: run_completion_loop → handle_stream → queue_stream_message → Coordinator.stream yields → Client.default_stream_builder → completion_stream → chat_stream_events
steps.state: stream_backlogs[rid].undelivered_bytes up on queue, down when the reader takes it; reader_idle_since_s refreshed.
steps.errors: Over max_total_backlog_bytes, the stream with the longest-idle reader fails as a whole (QueueFullError).
steps.rationale: Whole-stream failure instead of dropping chunks: dropped chunks would corrupt the output.

steps.title: Thinker request finishes → result payload
steps.state: req._omni_terminal_claimed = True under request_admission_lock; KV released (close_completed_request).
steps.errors: If the request was aborted mid-step (FINISH_ABORT or in aborted_request_ids) the result is dropped and only cleanup runs.
steps.rationale: stream_output is where upstream would send to its detokenizer process; sglang-omni redirects it into the stage outbox.

steps.title: Thinker → decode: stream_done first, then the projected payload

code.anchor: # Send stream done to the active stream targets for this request.

steps.state: local_stream_targets[rid] ∋ "decode" (recorded by the stream_done send), which permits the local_object payload hop.
steps.errors: Routing failures → send_failure.
steps.rationale: stream_done is sent before the payload so a streaming consumer always sees end-of-stream; projection drops what decode does not read.

steps.title: Decode finalizes the result
steps.outputPayload:
stream=true:  {"events": [...], "finish_reason": ..., "usage": {...}, "modality": "text"}   # text popped: already streamed
stream=false: {"events": [...], "text": "<full answer>", "finish_reason": ..., "usage": {...}}
steps.state: request_states[rid] popped. Non-stream: stream_done arrived first with no state, so rid was parked in the bounded done_seen.
steps.errors: Exceptions isolate the request (error message to outbox).
steps.rationale: One decode stage serves both modes: streaming emits deltas as tokens arrive; non-streaming decodes once at the end.

steps.title: Terminal decode → CompleteMessage to Coordinator
steps.state: decode clear_request_state(rid).
steps.crossProcess: ZMQ PUSH → coordinator PULL. Pipeline process → HTTP process.
steps.errors: A send failure propagates in the outbox drain task.
steps.rationale: Terminal-ness comes from the config (terminal=True); the route function returns None for it.

steps.title: Coordinator resolves the request

code.anchor: # Fail-fast: any terminal failure -> fail entire request

steps.state: RequestInfo removed; completion future done.
steps.errors: success=False: state=FAILED, AbortMessage broadcast on PUB, future/stream failed (fail-fast).
steps.rationale: With one expected terminal the result resolves immediately; the speech pipeline instead collects decode + code2wav in partial_results and merges.

steps.title: HTTP response: JSON body or SSE finish + [DONE]
steps.output: ChatCompletionResponse JSON / SSE finish chunk + data: [DONE]
steps.state: Coordinator.stream returns once all expected terminals completed; its finally releases the stream queue.
steps.errors: After streaming starts, errors are sent in-band as data: {"error": ...} then [DONE] (chat_stream).
steps.rationale: Client aggregation keeps text, audio and usage assembly out of the HTTP layer.

steps.title: Admission: audio requested → two terminal stages
steps.state: requests[rid].terminal_stages = {decode, code2wav}
steps.errors: As in the text path.
steps.rationale: Audio is opt-in over HTTP: the chat route fills output_modalities with ["text"] unless modalities is given; a missing field would mean audio.

steps.title: Preprocessing routes to thinker AND talker_ar (SHM)
steps.state: relay buffers held until each receiver's DataAckMessage
steps.crossProcess: Separate processes in the speech config: tensors via SHM relay, DataReadyMessage over ZMQ, DataAckMessage back.
steps.errors: Relay read failure at the receiver → negative ACK + send_failure.
steps.rationale: The talker gets the prompt early so it can start as soon as a few thinker tokens exist.

steps.title: Thinker and talker each fan in (no mm_aggregate)
steps.output: thinker: full thinker_inputs; talker: prompt + thinker_inputs only
steps.state: AggregatedInput.pending per stage until expected sources arrive
steps.errors: Unexpected source → ValueError.
steps.rationale: The speech config moves fan-in into the AR stages themselves; wait_for_fn narrows sources per request.

steps.title: Talker payload waits: not build-ready yet
steps.outputPayload: ready = usable_chunks >= partial_start_min_chunks (5 in the default speech config, 1 colocated)
steps.state: deferred until enough thinker chunks or stream_done
steps.rationale: The talker prefill needs some thinker text rows; starting after a few tokens instead of the whole reply is the partial start.

steps.title: Thinker build: token budget capped by what the talker can say
steps.state: Req queued; prompt hidden states are captured for media prompts
steps.errors: As in the text path.
steps.rationale: A reply longer than the talker's codec budget could not be fully spoken.

steps.title: Each thinker token streams to decode and talker_ar
steps.outputPayload: talker chunk: tensor([token_id]) (or prompt hidden rows on the first chunk when the prompt has media), metadata={token_id}
steps.state: req.is_prompt_hidden_handed_off set after the first talker chunk
steps.errors: Builder exception fails only this request.
steps.rationale: Talker consumes thinker text as it is produced, so speech starts long before the text reply ends.

steps.title: Tiny token chunks ride inline in StreamChunkBatchMessage
steps.input: CPU tensor ≤ 16 KiB, metadata without tensors
steps.output: StreamChunkBatchMessage(request_ids, chunk_ids, dtypes, shapes, tensor_bytes, pickled_metadata)
steps.outputPayload: one ZMQ message carrying every pending chunk for talker_ar
steps.state: nonlocal_stream_targets[rid] ∋ talker_ar
steps.crossProcess: ZMQ only; no relay. Chunks larger than 16 KiB (e.g. hidden rows) fall back to the SHM relay.
steps.errors: Unpack failure fails each affected request.
steps.rationale: A relay round trip per 8-byte token would dominate; batching amortizes it.

steps.title: Talker buffers chunks, then becomes build-ready

code.anchor: def on_stream_chunk(self, request_id: str, chunk: StreamItem) -> None:

steps.state: pending_stream_ingress[rid].chunks grows
steps.rationale: Chunks may arrive before or after the payload; both orders converge here.

steps.title: Talker request build: thinker text → talker prefill embeddings
steps.output: SGLangARRequestData with prefill input_embeds and pending_text_queue
steps.outputPayload: talker Req(input_embeds=[rows], pending_text_queue=[future text rows], max_new_tokens=talker_max_new_tokens)
steps.state: talker sampling: temperature 0.9, top_k 50, repetition_penalty 1.05, top 1024 codec ids suppressed except EOS
steps.errors: No prefetched chunks → RuntimeError.
steps.rationale: Text not yet consumed by the prefill is kept as a queue fed into later decode steps.

steps.title: Talker decode: feedback + next text; rows without text wait
steps.output: next codec token per ready row
steps.requestPayload: row input = feedback_embed(prev codec) + text_embed(next thinker token)
steps.outputPayload: excluded rows keep KV and rejoin when text arrives
steps.state: excluded_batch holds waiting rows for one step
steps.errors: Aborted rows with no input are cleaned up immediately.
steps.rationale: Speech must not run ahead of the text it speaks; excluding rows avoids padding with fake input.

steps.title: Talker emits codec codes to code2wav (CUDA IPC relay)
steps.state: pending_codec_rows, pending_feedback_queue per request
steps.crossProcess: GPU 1 → GPU 0: pooled CUDA IPC relay if peer access (else SHM); colocated config: local object + CUDA event.
steps.errors: Relay failure → stream error to the consumer → request failure.
steps.rationale: Early frames go one by one for first audio; later frames batch to match the code2wav window.

steps.title: code2wav ingests codes and decodes 10-frame windows
steps.state: audio_parts += window; pinned slot recycled after D2H copy
steps.errors: A failed window step fails its participants only.
steps.rationale: Windows with left context (25 frames) give continuous audio while streaming.

steps.title: Audio windows → Coordinator → SSE delta.audio
steps.input: StreamMessage(chunk={audio_waveform bytes, dtype, shape, sample_rate}, modality=audio)
steps.state: Coordinator stream backlog counts audio bytes
steps.crossProcess: ZMQ msgpack carries the audio bytes.
steps.errors: Backlog over max_total_backlog_bytes fails the slowest-reading stream.
steps.rationale: Text and audio deltas are interleaved as separate SSE events.

steps.title: Thinker finishes: stream_done to talker_ar and decode
steps.output: stream_done to [talker_ar, decode]; payload to decode
steps.state: talker: req_data.thinker_chunks_done = True (via stream_done_handler)
steps.rationale: The talker needs to know no more text is coming to finish its reply.

steps.title: Talker finishes: flush codes, latch payload to code2wav
steps.output: last code rows + stream_done + StagePayload(data={} or {NO_SPEECH: True})
steps.outputPayload: StagePayload(data={})   # a latch: codes already went by stream
steps.state: talker KV released
steps.rationale: Code tensors never ride the payload; the payload only closes the request at code2wav.

steps.title: code2wav final result → CompleteMessage
steps.function: flush last window → Code2WavScheduler.final_result_data → Stage.route_result (terminal) → send_complete
steps.outputPayload:
stream=true: {"modality": "audio", "sample_rate": 24000}
stream=false: full waveform payload (audio_waveform bytes, dtype, shape, sample_rate)
steps.state: codec slot released
steps.errors: No audio and no NO_SPEECH → RuntimeError → request failure.
steps.rationale: When streaming, the audio already went out; the final result carries only metadata.

steps.title: Coordinator waits for both terminals and merges
steps.state: partial_results[rid] until both arrive; then COMPLETED
steps.errors: Either terminal failing → fail-fast for the whole request.
steps.rationale: Text and audio finish independently; the client gets one result.

steps.title: Client attaches audio to the text result
steps.function: Client.default_result_builder (decode + code2wav) → set_audio_data → completion (base64 WAV) / SSE finish
steps.errors: No pipeline response → ClientError.
steps.rationale: Aggregation stays out of the HTTP layer.
